name: Toki no Hana -Chrono Alice-
source: Alice is a high schooler living in the "Showa" period, who meets a boy named Sho in the library, and the two instantly fall for each other. However, you find out that he's a high schooler from the "Reiwa" period. As "time" itself acts as a barrier for the two lovers, Alice also finds out that the library is struggling to stay open......
translation: 爱丽丝是一位生活在“昭和”时期的高中生，她在图书馆遇到了一个名叫翔的男孩，两人一见钟情。然而，你发现他是一名“令和”时代的高中生。由于“时间”本身就成为了两个恋人的障碍，爱丽丝还发现图书馆正在努力维持开放……
